measurement_tool: scripts/book_pipeline/pagination_diagnostics.run_render_experiments (existing render-experiment harness, extended with one new declared experiment: canonical_165x235_mirrored_geometry)
methodology: Real re-render via WeasyPrint through pdf_adapter.build_full_html() for the canonical CanonicalBookModel, with book_shared.build_print_css monkeypatched in-memory for the duration of one variant's render only (self-restoring). No estimation/extrapolation. RU and PL both ran through the exact same experiment implementation. No canonical artifact (book/pdf, book/epub, data/book-pagination*.json) was written by this measurement.

typography_held_constant.note: Only the @page size and @page :left/:right margin rules were patched; no heading, code, callout, or other component rule was touched.

experiment_geometry.source_of_approval: M03-I01 audit correction round — Binding Product Owner Decisions for M03, items 1-2

target.status: NOT YET REACHED — geometry alone moves RU from 2097 to an experimental 1767 and PL from 2035 to 1727; both remain well above the 850-1000 target. This step is measurement only; no claim of success toward the target is made.

root_cause_fix.defect: pagination_diagnostics._geometry_report() independently hardcoded stale production assumptions (font_size_pt=10.3, line_height_ratio=1.48) that had drifted from the print CSS's actual shipped values (9.8pt/1.26).
root_cause_fix.fix: Introduced one canonical, language-independent set of print-layout constants in scripts/book_shared.py (PRINT_PAGE_WIDTH_MM, PRINT_PAGE_HEIGHT_MM, PRINT_MARGIN_TOP_MM, PRINT_MARGIN_RIGHT_MM, PRINT_MARGIN_BOTTOM_MM, PRINT_MARGIN_LEFT_MM, PRINT_BODY_FONT_SIZE_PT, PRINT_BODY_LINE_HEIGHT_RATIO). build_print_css() now interpolates these constants into its @page/body CSS template instead of hardcoding literals; pagination_diagnostics._geometry_report() now reads the same book_shared constants instead of its own local literals. Verified byte-identical CSS output before/after the refactor.
root_cause_fix.verification: tests/test_m03_i02_step1_canonical_geometry.py (13 new tests) plus tests/test_pagination_diagnostics.py (updated for the new experiment name).

test_results.full_suite: pytest tests/ — 399 passed in 309.95s, zero failures, zero skips beyond pre-existing skip conditions
